get.description: Returns the current public and internal knowledge base training status for a specific AI agent.

200.description: AI agent training status retrieved successfully

aiAgentId.description: The AI agent's unique identifier.

internalStatus.description: Internal training state used by the training worker.

updatedSourcesCount.description: Number of included knowledge entries updated since the last successful training run.

canTrainAt.description: When the next training run is allowed under the current plan cooldown. Null means training may be started immediately.

lastTrainedAt.description: When the knowledge base was last trained successfully.

trainingStartedAt.description: When the current or last training run started.

trainedItemsCount.description: How many knowledge items were included in the last successful training run.

lastError.description: Last training error message, if any.

schema.description: Current knowledge base training status for an AI agent, including both public and internal state.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing private API key

403.description: Forbidden - Private API key required

post.description: Queues a retraining job for the AI agent knowledge base. Requires a private API key. When using an unlinked private key, send `X-Actor-User-Id` with a valid website teammate ID.

parameters.name: X-Actor-User-Id
parameters.description: Acting teammate identifier for unlinked private API keys. Required on actor-aware private routes when the private key is not linked to a team member. Ignored when the private key is linked.

202.description: AI agent training job queued successfully

aiAgentId.description: The AI agent's unique identifier.

status.description: Public-facing status immediately after a retraining job has been queued.

internalStatus.description: Initial internal worker status immediately after the job is queued.

schema.description: Response returned after a knowledge base retraining job has been queued.

400.description: Bad request - Missing required actor header for an unlinked private key

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing private API key

403.description: Forbidden - Private API key required or actor is not allowed for this website

409.description: Conflict - Training is already in progress

429.description: Too Many Requests - Training cooldown has not elapsed yet

get.description: Retrieves a single AI agent by ID for the authenticated website.

image.description: The AI agent's profile image URL.

description.description: A brief description of the AI agent's purpose.

temperature.description: The temperature setting for response generation (0-2).

lastUsedAt.description: When the AI agent was last used.

usageCount.description: Total number of times the AI agent has been used.

goals.description: The goals/intents for this AI agent.

createdAt.description: When the AI agent was created.

updatedAt.description: When the AI agent was last updated.

get.description: Returns the website information associated with the provided API key. This endpoint supports both public and private API keys with different authentication methods.
